sentences.text: No upper limit or cap for penal charges has been prescribed for a UCB, and the bank is told to keep in mind that penal charges are not meant to be used as a revenue enhancement tool.

For a UCB, default-related penalty is to be levied only as penal charges and not as penal interest, and those penal charges must be reasonable and levied only on the amount under default in a non-discriminatory manner as per the Board-approved policy.
The directions also say there is no capitalization of penal charges and no additional penal charges on earlier outstanding penal charges.
The earlier 2023 RBI penal-charges circulars for primary urban co-operative banks were superseded by the 2025 UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions.
